title: 1958 AHSME Problem 8
statement: Which of these four numbers, \(\sqrt{\pi^2},\) \(\sqrt[3]{0.8},\) \(\sqrt[4]{0.00016},\) \(\sqrt[3]{-1}\cdot\sqrt{(0.09)^{-1}},\) is (are) rational?

solutions.text:
The first number is \(\pi,\) which is irrational. The cube root of \(\frac{4}{5}\) is irrational. Also \[ \sqrt[4]{0.00016} =\sqrt[4]{16\cdot10^{-5}} \] is irrational. The fourth number is \[ (-1)\sqrt{\frac{100}{9}}=-\frac{10}{3}, \] which is rational.

Therefore, only the fourth is rational, and the correct answer is D.
hints: Evaluate each radical separately and remember that \(\pi\) is irrational
